summary.name: Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research
summary.one_liner: JAIR is an open academic journal that publishes research results across all areas of artificial intelligence.
use_cases: Reading recent artificial intelligence research papers
Finding academic papers on machine learning
Looking up research on planning and scheduling
summary.what_it_does: The page describes the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research as dedicated to the rapid dissemination of important research results to the global AI community. Its stated scope covers agents and multi-agent systems, automated reasoning, constraint processing and search, knowledge representation, machine learning, natural language, planning and scheduling, robotics and vision, and uncertainty in AI. The page lists Vol. 87 (2026) as the current issue, published 2026-09-11. The page text does not describe submission process, access terms or fees.
notable: Covers all major areas of AI in a single journal
Aims for rapid dissemination of research results
caveats: Page does not state whether articles are free to access or cost money
Page text is brief and does not describe submission or licensing details
